title: 麗莎深水開發
summary: 麗莎是蓋亞那 Stabroek 開發的一部分；本課以浮式生產連接海底、船體與出貨三個工程界面。本課依序分析船體新增重量、來液波動與分離、卸油間隔庫存、海底連接液相損失、海陸產品量對帳，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Liza is part of Guyana’s Stabroek development; the case connects subsea production, floating inventory and export interfaces. The course analyses added weight on a floating hull, inlet variation and separation, inventory between offloading events, liquid losses along subsea connections, offshore-to-shore product reconciliation, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 船體新增重量、來液波動與分離、卸油間隔庫存
v31FocusEn: Added weight on a floating hull; Inlet variation and separation; Inventory between offloading events

quiz.question: 關於「船體新增重量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Added weight on a floating hull" is correct?
options: 漂浮平衡時排開海水的重量必須等於系統重量，水面面積控制新增重量造成的吃水變化。
只要總排水量足夠，模組放在任何位置都一樣。
停留時間足夠長就保證所有乳化油水完全分離。
optionsEn: At floating equilibrium the weight of displaced seawater equals system weight, while waterplane area controls draft change from added mass.
Adequate total displacement means modules can be placed anywhere.
A long residence time guarantees complete separation of every emulsion.
quiz.explanation: 漂浮平衡時排開海水的重量必須等於系統重量，水面面積控制新增重量造成的吃水變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At floating equilibrium the weight of displaced seawater equals system weight, while waterplane area controls draft change from added mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「船體新增重量」。麗莎是蓋亞那 Stabroek 開發的一部分；本課以浮式生產連接海底、船體與出貨三個工程界面。在「麗莎深水開發」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。漂浮平衡時排開海水的重量必須等於系統重量，水面面積控制新增重量造成的吃水變化。這個一階模型把水線面積視為常數，不計船形曲率、自由液面和縱傾，因此適合做重量帳的敏感度而非完整穩度計算。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Added weight on a floating hull”. Liza is part of Guyana’s Stabroek development; the case connects subsea production, floating inventory and export interfaces. In the teaching model for Liza deepwater development, separate this interface from adjacent equipment before applying the following method. At floating equilibrium the weight of displaced seawater equals system weight, while waterplane area controls draft change from added mass. This first-order model holds waterplane area constant and excludes hull curvature, free-surface effects and trim. It supports weight-account sensitivity rather than a complete stability assessment. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 船體新增重量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Added weight on a floating hull: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船體新增重量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Added weight on a floating hull” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δdraft = ΔM/(rho A)；代入 M = 1500 tonne added mass、rho = 1025 kg/m³、A = 18000 m² waterplane area，得 0.0813 m（「船體新增重量」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 M 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δdraft = ΔM/(rho A); with M = 1500 tonne added mass, rho = 1025 kg/m³, A = 18000 m² waterplane area the result is 0.0813 m (simplified exercise for Added weight on a floating hull; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise M by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：M 增加 10% 時，結果變為 0.0894 m（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising M by 10% changes the result to 0.0894 m (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 0.0813 m（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 M 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 0.0813 m (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in M with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Added weight on a floating hull” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「船體新增重量」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把新增模組的假設質量代入吃水增量，與排水體積守恆交叉核對；再列出重量位置改變但總重量不變時本模型漏掉的效應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Added weight on a floating hull”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Calculate draft increment for a hypothetical added module, cross-check displaced-volume conservation, and identify effects omitted when weight position changes without changing total mass. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 021-01 標記，圖表須寫明「麗莎深水開發：教學假設」。把吃水估算與重心、縱傾、自由液面三項限制分開呈現，模型不取代海事穩度審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 021-01 and mark charts “Liza deepwater development: teaching assumptions”. Present draft screening separately from centre of gravity, trim and free-surface constraints; the model does not replace marine stability review.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「船體新增重量」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Added weight on a floating hull” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 船體新增重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Added weight on a floating hull: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船體新增重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Added weight on a floating hull” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「船體新增重量」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。重量清冊漏項會造成排水量預測偏低；液艙自由液面可降低穩度，即使平均吃水仍接近預測也不能忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「麗莎深水開發」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Added weight on a floating hull” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Missing items in the weight register underpredict displacement; free liquid surfaces can reduce stability even when mean draft remains close to prediction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Liza deepwater development”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個一階模型把水線面積視為常數，不計船形曲率、自由液面和縱傾，因此適合做重量帳的敏感度而非完整穩度計算。
